commits.summary: Set lineBreakMode for text fields in OakChooser windows
commits.body: We already setup proper line break mode for the strings displayed (via paragraph attributes), but having good defaults makes sense, so subclasses can forego setting it.

commits.summary: Do not use ‘new metadata only’ option with replaceItemAtURL:…
commits.body: We want to preserve the existing file’s metadata, although we manually take steps to do so, but no reason to disable the system’s functionality for this.

commits.summary: Set the frame size via NSTitlebarAccessoryViewController's view property
commits.body: When linking against the macos 11.0 SDK, the view size fails to update.

commits.summary: Add "Close Tabs to the Left" as alternate of "Close Tabs to the Right"
commits.body:
This is useful when working with one set of files in a project, then moving to another set without closing the original set first.

Alternate menu items are pretty subtle, but there are already a lot of ways to close tabs, and I didn't want to clutter the menu further.

commits.summary: Remove dependency on libressl
Use Security framework to decode license keys (instead of libressl)
commits.body: This avoids a third party dependency.

commits.summary: Selections from regexp searches would be “anchored”
commits.body: Normally a selection done via search or double-click will be unanchored, so that the first use of shift-left/right will always extend the selection, as opposed to a selection done with keyboard, where shift-left/right moves the ending of the selection.

commits.summary: Leave out kCTUnderlinePatternSolid because of warning mixing enums
commits.body: The value of this constant is zero, so it is unnecessary to include.

commits.summary: Use os_log_error instead of custom debug output macro
Remove commented debug output lines
Send ‘length’ to attributed string instead of via string property
Do not declare a few ‘auto’ loop variables as also being ‘const’
commits.body: This produces a warning with latest Xcode, stating that it produces a copy, as the variable is already const. This does seem a little strange, so it could be a problem with the analyzer, but not marking these variables const shouldn’t affect anything.

commits.summary: Do not make software update fixtures in ./configure file
commits.body: These fixtures were removed in cfb523e713a9685aec69e52cac849391f2f36cae

commits.summary: Improve how we add styles when syntax highlighting find/replace strings
commits.body:
We only set underline and strikethrough when those are enabled, and use applyFontTraits:range: instead of explicitly setting the font.

The latter should avoid breaking font substitution, although to be safe, we still call fixFontAttributeInRange:.

commits.summary: NewApplication template: Change perform{FindPanel → TextFinder}Action:
Copying search results are again stored on clipboard as a single string
commits.body:
I have not found it advantageous to get multiple carets when pasting search results, on the contrary, if we have a significant number of results, the multiple carets may impact performance.

This reverts the change that was made in 82593c88240f63fdb3bd5453b94a1d415aa8b65a.

commits.summary: File browser’s field editor (rename) would stay after pressing return
commits.body:
This problem started after f1a1e1920f76687bd64095404deadbe8007ee134 (handling key equivalents in performKeyEquivalent: instead of keyDown:).

It does however not appear that it is necessary to manually handle the return key to activate editing, therefore we have removed handling of this key.

Most likely it was required before view-based table views.

commits.summary: Add “Create Link to Items” file browser context menu action
commits.body:
This will create symbolic links to the files on the clipboard.

It is equivalent to holding down control (⌃) when dropping files on the file browser.

commits.summary: Begin-of-line zero-width search results would not show any content
commits.body: This would happen if searching for an anchor that would match at the beginning of a line, e.g. ‘\A’ or ‘^’, with zero actual characters matched.

commits.summary: Remove initialization of libcurl
commits.body: We no longer use libcurl anywhere in TextMate, so this line is no longer necessary.

commits.summary: Set (visible) key equivalents for file browser context menu
commits.body: Some of the items require the key equivalent to be set as “inactive” as menu item keys are “global” and thus need to be unique, and can be triggered even when the view containing the context menu is not active.

commits.summary: Only update file browser menu item titles when it is the explicit target
commits.body:
Previously “Paste Next” in the Edit → Paste submenu could have its title updated to “Move Item Here”, which would never be restored back to “Paste Next”, similarly for regular paste.

This commit also drops the wrappers for the cut:, copy:, paste:, and delete: methods, as these wrappers resulted in a bit of redundancy related to menu item validation.

commits.summary: Remove redundant target setting from file browser context menu
commits.body: We set target for all items in the menu during post-processing.

commits.summary: Let file browser call copyAsPathname: when seeing ⌥⌘C
commits.body: We cannot do this via a menu item because this key equivalent is already used for Ignore Case in the Edit → Find → Find Options menu.

commits.summary: Handle file browser shortcuts in performKeyEquivalent:
commits.body:
This is called before the main menu acts on keys, and thus allows us to catch keys that are otherwise assigned to menu items.

We only do this when the file browser is first responder, so it should be acceptable to have a few menu keys change behavior in that case.

commits.summary: Use os_log_error when assertions fail
Change target file for OakDebug to not link as a bundle
commits.body: This was from back when each framework was built independently.

commits.summary: Remove majority of code from OakDebug framework
Remove comment about _GLIBCXX_DEBUG
commits.body: Unsure if this has any meaning for libc++.

commits.summary: Remove include of <oak/debug/OakDebugLog.h>
Remove use of WATCH_LEAKS (C++)
Remove use of OBJC_WATCH_LEAKS
Remove commented debug statements
Move BSTR macro to crash/info.h
Avoid using BSTR macro in OakDocument.mm
commits.body: This is a debug macro that shouldn’t be used by non-debug code.

commits.summary: Remove ‘to_s’ functions previously used by log statements
Remove all debug output from custom log macros
commits.body:
This provided value during early development, but has been unused for years, and it would generate too much noise if converted to os_log.

So better to just remove it all and add os_log statements as needed.

commits.summary: Call os_log_error if AESendMessage fails
Remove PUBLIC macro
Don’t annotate types and classes with PUBLIC
commits.body: This was required when we linked each framework as its own thing, which we do not do anymore, and if we do go back to this system, we can simply have symbols public by default.

commits.summary: Use a custom class for favorite items (instead of NSDictionary)
Use ‘valueForKey:’ to get ‘path’ from items in didSelectFavorite:
commits.body: This allows path to be either stored in a dictionary (as currently done) or be a getter method of a custom subclass.

commits.summary: Remove find_t::match API
Update find tests to use find_t::each_match
commits.body: These tests are not exactly exhaustive and should probably be amended with more edge cases, especially now that the API has been simplified (so easier to add more tests).

commits.summary: Use new find_t::each_match in folder search
Use new find_t::each_match in document search
Add simpler (low-level) API for performing a search
Remove API to set skip offset when performing a search
Files with .mm.rl extension are now built as Objective-C++
commits.body: Previously all .rl files would be built as C++.

commits.summary: Use longest suffix match when more than one build rule can build a file
commits.body: For example we may specify a transform for ‘.rl → .cc’ and another for ‘.mm.rl → .mm’. For a file named ‘fsm.mm.rl’ the build system would use the first rule seen, now it will always pick the latter, as it matches more of the suffix.

commits.summary: Abort iterating over parent URLs if the path string grows in length
commits.body:
It appears that NSURL’s algorithm for “delete last path component” is to first append ‘../’ and then “normalize” the result, but the latter step can fail for some file URLs, for example with “file://localhost/path/to/https://macromates.com/” it will be stuck at the two slashes (continuing to append ‘../’).

Such malformed (file) URL can be created by running ‘mate https://macromates.com/’.

commits.summary: Minor tweak of log message
Tweak layout constraints of footer in Select Bundle Item window
commits.body:
I occasionally see the Edit or Select button stretched, i.e. the status bar text field hugs its content fully, this is despite its hugging priority being set to low.

I did try to set it to NSLayoutPriorityDefaultLow-10 (assuming hugging priority of the buttons is NSLayoutPriorityDefaultLow), but I still saw the problem, so now we just allow space between the status bar and the buttons, rather than rely on the status bar to be stretched.

commits.summary: Usage text for the process_plist script was using a wrong program name
Support passing arguments to ragel via RAGEL_FLAGS
commits.body: The default for ragel is to generate compact and flexible code, not an issue for our current use case (parsing only comments and strings in ASCII property lists) but in the future we may need to tweak the output as ragel will be used for other things.

commits.summary: Let ninja run tests in the console pool
commits.body:
I think it will prevent multiple tests from being run in parallel, but when writing tests, we may produce a lot of output, that should not be buffered by ninja.

A future improvement could be to only use the console pool for the tests of the current target, but that will require two different rules to run tests.

commits.summary: Improve how we update key view loop in transition view controller
Let preferences window recalculate key view loop and set first responder
commits.body: None of our preference panes have custom key view loops, therefore it is safe to call recalculateKeyViewLoop, if however we do introduce custom key view loops, we will need to update this code to account for that.

commits.summary: Do not recalculate key view loop in OakTransitionViewController
commits.body: Also do not change first responder, as this belongs at a higher level, where we know which view would be a suitable first responder.

commits.summary: Improve check for setting first responder for bundles preferences
commits.body: For example when opening the window for the first time, the first responder will already have been setup when reaching the viewDidAppear method.

commits.summary: Don’t call OakSetupKeyViewLoop with just a single view
commits.body: In this case, the function is a no-op.

commits.summary: Don’t set autorecalculatesKeyViewLoop to NO (as it is the default value)
Remove support for initial first responder in OakSetupKeyViewLoop
Do not rely on OakSetupKeyViewLoop to set initial first responder
commits.body:
We either set it explicitly or rely on automatic key view loop calculations.

As for the latter: When auto-layout was initially introduced, the automatic key view loop calculation broke, as it used the view frames before layout. It should have been fixed several OS versions ago though, so we can use it again, as long as we are not working with view-based table views.

commits.summary: Remove support for NSNull in OakSetupKeyViewLoop
commits.body: Also specify the object type (NSView*) for the arrays passed to OakSetupKeyViewLoop and OakAddAutoLayoutViewsToSuperview.

commits.summary: Do not pass NSNull objects to OakSetupKeyViewLoop for non-existing views
commits.body: We only need this in one location, and it’s easy to handle at that call-site, rather than add complexity to something which is already a little opaque.

commits.summary: Improve log message for a failed download
Move OakCompareVersionStrings function to SoftwareUpdate framework
Move OakDownloadManager to SoftwareUpdate framework
Rewrite SoftwareUpdate singleton
commits.body:
Changes:

- Use NSURLSession and OakDownloadManager to download updates (instead of libcurl).
- Use NSFileManager’s replaceItemAtURL:… to update the application bundle (instead of custom code).
- Use NSTask to relaunch the application (instead of fork/exec).
- Use the same window for the initial prompt, and for showing download progress.
- Show estimated time remaining in download window (via NSProgress).
- Allow retrying downloads on various forms of failures.
- Don’t require xib file for download window.

Regressions:

- We no longer support updating the application as root: I tried using an authorized NSFileManager instance, but it did not work for me, and the previous code we used for this was using legacy APIs.

commits.summary: Remove version::less (C++) API
Switch from using version::less → OakCompareVersionStrings
Introduce OakCompareVersionStrings wrapper and use in tests
Change version.cc from C++ to Objective-C++
Add read/write subview property to OakTransitionViewController
commits.body: This feels like a better API than the previous transitionToView: method.

commits.summary: Connect “Check Now” button directly to software update controller
Remove log message when trying to update bundle index
commits.body: This already happens in an os_activity block which produce a similar log message.

commits.summary: Remove tests for software update framework
commits.body: The code being tested is scheduled for replacement and it’ll be too cumbersome to update these tests.

commits.summary: Rename OakNetworkManager files to OakDownloadManager
Rename OakNetworkManager class to OakDownloadManager
Let software update preferences bind directly to user defaults
commits.body: We would go through ‘self’ only to unify things in the xib file, as some values are stored via .tm_properties.

commits.summary: Remove ‘lastPoll’ property from software update controller
Refactor software update preferences
commits.body:
We now use kUserDefaultsLastSoftwareUpdateCheckKey to obtain “last check” and observe user defaults for changes.

Also eliminate local mirroring of software update controller properties and other minor tweaks.

commits.summary: Make kUserDefaultsLastSoftwareUpdateCheckKey public
Obtain OS version via NSProcessInfo.processInfo.operatingSystemVersion
commits.body: The oak::os_major, oak::os_minor, and oak::os_patch functions are wrapping deprecated API.

commits.summary: Use compile-time string concatenation instead of %s
Change key (in session state) used to store file browser state
commits.body:
We changed the type of file browser state from NSDictionary → NSData in 4a1e9113f38174404f1ca4a50f1b2a8b61007904.

While we do check the type of the object read, previous versions did not, so if the user runs latest version of TextMate, and then downgrades, they will have state that cannot be read by the older version of TextMate (and will cause exception during launch, incase file browser state is restored).

commits.summary: Rename methods and constants to use software update in singular form
commits.body: The program only checks for a single update.

commits.summary: Don’t let software update framework expose DownloadWindowController
Move software update signing key to Info.plist
commits.body: This simplifies usage of the software update singleton and still allows to use it in other projects that have different signing key(s).

commits.summary: Change variable name: observerId → token
commits.body:
Several places already used ‘token’ as the name for the result from NSNotificationCenter’s addObserver:… so this change is to be consistent.

While ‘token’ is less meaningful than ‘observerId’, the variable is only used with NSNotificationCenter API where the context makes it clear.

commits.summary: Make token used in notification block weak as it retains the block
commits.body: This is not made clear from the documentation, however, the documentation does state that the token will be strongly held by the notification center, until the notification is removed, therefore it is safe to only keep a weak reference to the token (even if the implementation should change).

commits.summary: Update URL schemes (mainly in comments) to use https
Use constants for find panel and font manager tag values in main menu
Close NSFileHandle instances obtained from NSPipe when done writing
commits.body: The documentation is not clear on whether or not file handles from an NSPipe will be automatically closed, so to be safe, we close them manually.

commits.summary: Use NSDictionary for SCM repository variables (instead of std::map)
Check for NULL_STR when producing error message from uuid_t constructor
Use a dynamic name for the commit window’s service
Update to use non-deprecated NSButtonType constant names
Clear background when using a theme with transparent background
commits.body:
This partially reverts 6ffd0f2e92466355de0e81ed915b8e32daa8a3de

While we do not support transparent themes per se, we still use the alpha colors and thus would previously fill the background using alpha, into a layer that we hadn’t previously cleared.

commits.summary: Use std::optional for variable lookup function used by format string
Use std::optional for the result of scope::selector_t::does_match
commits.body: This does change ranking of the wildcard scope selector, as incase of a wildcard match, the old code did not change the rank, so it would be up the caller, which was 1 for bundle item matching but 0 for settings and theme matching.

commits.summary: Use std::optional for the result of item_t::does_match
commits.body: This avoids having to pass a pointer for the actual rank (incase of a match).

commits.summary: Avoid accessing the find results view until we really need it
commits.body: This is to postpone constructing the view: It’s probably not costly to construct it before we need it, but everything adds up, and it just feels proper to avoid constructing the views of view controllers until as late as possible.

commits.summary: Do not create Find dialog until loadWindow is called
Fix vertical truncation of checkbox labels in find dialog
commits.body: We now add some bottom padding to the containing grid view, as it may be oblivious to alignment rectangles, and would therefore snap to the bottom of the checkbox label’s alignment rectangle, clipping anything drawn outside of it.

commits.summary: Checkin release notes for 2.0.15
QuickLook plug-in selects theme the same as TextMate (supporting auto)
Avoid potential crash by not updating window’s opaque property
commits.body:
This does completely remove support for transparent themes, but any recent version of macOS would not support it anyway due to layer-backed views.

The crash resulting from setting opaque is because of recursion: After session restore, the window will calculate shadow, this triggers a “user defaults did change” notification, which updates theme of text view, which sets opaque, which re-calculates shadow and tries to recursively obtain a non-recursive mutex.

commits.summary: Improve API for adding a folder submenu
Simplify implementation of parentMenuItem
Checkin release notes for 2.0.14
Fix crash in AboutWindowController when license owner is nil
Checkin release notes for 2.0.13
Allow building with the macOS 10.14 SDK
commits.body: This does mean that NSRelativeDateTimeFormatter is not used, even when running on macOS 10.15.

commits.summary: Change layout constraints to allow superview with zero width
commits.body: I occasionally see log entries saying that the constraints cannot be resolved, and it appears to be because the superview has a width of zero.

commits.summary: Expose automatic theme switching in View → Themes submenu
commits.body: Theme is now stored only with OakTextView (observed by OakDocumentView) and the “global” setting is stored in user defaults (not Global.tmProperties), though it is still possible to override theme on a file-by-file basis via .tm_properties files.

commits.summary: Pass theme to OakDocumentView instead of querying settings in the object
commits.body: This is because OakDocumentView is not in the view hierarchy and it obtains the theme via settings_t, so there is no way to notify about theme changes.

commits.summary: Add status bar to Bundles preferences showing when index was updated
commits.body: It also shows a progress spinner when installing bundles and potential errors.

commits.summary: Change Nightly Builds to Prereleases in Software Update preferences
Call NSMenu’s numberOfItems instead of itemArray.count
Deliver all NSUserDefaultsDidChangeNotification in main queue
commits.body: This is easier than ensuring that we do not update user defaults from a background thread.

commits.summary: Don’t let HTMLOutputWindowController handle toggleHTMLOutput:
commits.body: Now that the window is a panel, we can rely on the main window to close the window on toggle, even with the HTML window having key.

commits.summary: Let app delegate handle workaround for “Move to Active Space” behavior
commits.body: I don’t think the default behavior ever makes sense, so we are applying the change to all windows instead of handling it on a one-by-one basis.

commits.summary: Use NSWindowController as superclass for HTMLOutputWindowController
Improve the folder pop-up submenu for Find in Folder
commits.body:
The submenu now show the immediate children in the first submenu, with parents below these items, although without adding submenus to the parents.

Also show ⌘↑ for the first parent, to improve discoverability of this key equivalent.

commits.summary: Use CGContext instead of graphicsPort
Make sure we always return a document from documentWithPath:
commits.body: Based on crash reports, there appears to be a race condition where the weak pointer has been nilled.

commits.summary: Remove properties related to install progress from BundlesManager
Introduce singleton to store state about bundles being installed
Show relative dates as “1 day ago” instead of “yesterday”
commits.body: Main reason I picked the named styles was that a time interval of zero would show as “in 0 seconds”, but we now check if check was less than 5 seconds ago and use “Just now” for that case.

commits.summary: Allow escape to dismiss HTML output window (by using NSPanel)
Eliminate redundant content view in About window
Use WKWebView in the about window
commits.body: To get scroll content behind title/toolbar we need to set NSWindowStyleMaskFullSizeContentView which appears to have been inferred with the old (deprecated) WebView.

commits.summary: Use NSPanel for the about window
commits.body: This is basically just so that we can close it with the escape key.

commits.summary: Use a Dark Mode media query for the About window’s CSS colors
Remove unused user defaults key
Use NSBackgroundActivityScheduler for updating bundle index
Add os/activity.h to list of headers to precompile
Only use implicit animation to resize windows on 10.15 and later
commits.body: This causes lots of visual glitches on macOS 10.14.

commits.summary: Prior to 10.15 a window’s screen property could be nil
Checkin release notes for 2.0.12
Find History: Change Find Next to “in Project” when holding down option
Allow toggling chooser windows (⌘T, ⇧⌘T, ⌃⌘T, ⇧⌘O)
commits.body:
If the window already has keyboard focus, sending it an “open” will instead close it, similar to pressing escape.

This might be useful for touch bar users.

commits.summary: Allow opening “Find in Project” from pasteboard history chooser
commits.body: This is triggered by holding option when selecting Find Next. Improving discoverability is work in progress.

commits.summary: Add an alternateAction property to OakPasteboardChooser
commits.body: This is sent when the action button is triggered while option (⌥) is down (if there is a valid responder for the message).

commits.summary: Log the localized string from NSError instead of the entire object
Go back to visual formal language for laying out the Find dialog
commits.body: Now that we use OakTransitionViewController for toggling the results view, using a stack view provides no real benefits, and are in some ways a little bit more opaque, for example the hugging priority weirdness and what width constraints are setup by the view.

commits.summary: Move initialization of view controllers from helper method to init
commits.body: These view controllers are used in other methods, so we were basically relying on the order of which methods were called, which is not good design.

commits.summary: Only install event monitor when results outline view is visible
Make sure window is within visible screen frame when resizing
Use OakTransitionViewController to show/hide find results
Move transitioning of view (animation) to stand-alone view controller
commits.body: Also make the code slightly more general, for example support transitions to nil.

commits.summary: Minor change in implementation of toolbar:itemForItemIdentifier:
commits.body:
We now always return an NSToolbarItem instance, even when we don’t actually have a view controller for the identifier.

This should not arise in practice, but it makes it easier to test new items in the toolbar (by only adding the identifier).

commits.summary: Increase row spacing in preferences pane grid view
Fix issue with ⌘F not bringing find dialog to active space
commits.body:
The problem is that we use ⌘F and ⇧⌘F as key equivalents both in the Edit → Find submenu and in the “where” pop-up button’s menu, but as they previously had different action methods, the system would only allow the key to trigger one of these items (and remove the key from the other, as part of menu validation).

Normally not an issue, but when the find dialog is in another space, it appears menu validation would not update the Find → Edit submenu items to get the key equivalents, even though these would be “first responders”.

By using same action method for both Find → Edit submenu items and the “where” pop-up menu items, we avoid the key equivalents being removed from any of the two menus.

commits.summary: Use FFSearchTarget instead of find_tags enumeration
commits.body: This avoids the need to map between the two enumeration constants, although we handle some of the constants before passing them to the find singleton, so the code has not yet been updated to remove the redundant mappings.

commits.summary: Include Move to Active Space in preferences window’s collection behavior
Use NSPanel for preferences window to support dismissing with escape
Use MBMenuBuilder to construct “where” pop-up menu in Find dialog
Remove initialKeyView from PreferencesPaneProtocol
Cross-fade when switching between preferences panes
Let the bundles preferences view controller set first responder itself
commits.body: This is instead of using the initialKeyView property. The latter is more declarative, and thus more abstracted / flexible, but we only need it for a single preferences pane, and the downside is that the generic code to “swap views” has to implement support for it, which I would like to avoid.

commits.summary: Remove MASPreferences submodule
Remove code required by MASPreferences
Use custom code for preferences window
commits.body:
Relying on “modern” APIs we can eliminate most of the MASPreferencesViewController protocol:

- viewIdentifier → identifier
- toolbarItemLabel → title
- initialKeyView → call makeFirstResponder: in viewDidAppear
- hasResizableWidth / hasResizableHeight → use auto layout constraints

Furthermore, handling the preferences panes can be done by using child view controllers, and it might even be possible to use transitionFromViewController:toViewController:options:completionHandler: to switch between the views.

The last point is actually the motivation for this change, as I need a playground for animated view transitions.

commits.summary: Implement preferredContentSize for terminal preferences
commits.body: This currently has no effect as the view uses autoresizing masks (which do not make the width/height sizable).

commits.summary: Set hugging priority for grid view instead of constraining width/height
commits.body: None of our grid views are actually sizable, but those containing text fields should probably have adjustable width.

commits.summary: Set hugging priority for stack view in Software Update preferences
commits.body: This prevents the containing grid view to increase the height of the stack view (introducing whitespace in the layout).

commits.summary: Use NSLayoutPriorityDefaultHigh-1 as hugging priority for stack views
commits.body:
When set to NSLayoutPriorityDefaultHigh then it is able to compress text fields. The text field does set content compression resistance to NSLayoutPriorityDefaultHigh, but for reasons I do not understand, this is not enough to keep it from being compressed by the stack view.

The reason I do not understand this is that even with a high hugging priority, we should not make views smaller than their fittingSize, but it appears the stack view will do that.

Only one stack view actually contained a text field, and we already used a priority lower than NSLayoutPriorityDefaultHigh, so this commit does not change anything, but to play it safe, we should probably avoid NSLayoutPriorityDefaultHigh for stack views.

commits.summary: Use selectControllerWithIdentifier: instead of selectControllerAtIndex:
Let toolbarItemLabel + viewIdentifier be wrappers for title + identifier
commits.body:
We might as well use the standard properties to store label/title and identifier.

It indirectly fixes a bug, as the code that generates the ⌘1-n menu would look at identifier instead of viewIdentifier to find selected item (so no item was shown as selected).

commits.summary: Use NSNibName instead of NSString*
Don’t associate real name with public signing keys
commits.body: They already have a unique identifier.

commits.summary: Use OakNetworkManager for updating bundles
Add OakNetworkManager
commits.body: This is destined to replace the existing network code based on libcurl.

commits.summary: Move can_reach_host out of network framework
commits.body: We only call this function from a single place, so no need to make it public API.

commits.summary: Change most fprintf log statements to using os_log
Ensure empty string is used when find dialog text field is empty
commits.body: The system will return ‘nil’ for empty text field, which was causing the replace preview in the find dialog to not show any replacements, and if doing actual replacements, 0xFFFF would be inserted for replacements.

commits.summary: Use NSNotificationName as type of all our notification names
Use UNUserNotificationCenter starting with macOS 10.14
commits.body: The advantage seems to be that we can delay asking for user permission until we actually have to post a notification, where the old API would immediately prompt the user, as we setup the NSUserNotificationCenter delegate in applicationDidFinishLaunching: (required to handle user clicking notifications).

commits.summary: Use NSBackgroundActivityScheduler to schedule crash reporting
Remove ‘post_to_server’ API (based on libcurl)
Rewrite crash reporting to use NSURLSessionUploadTask
Fix a few double trailing semi-colons
Only use NSRelativeDateTimeFormatter when 10.15 SDK is available
commits.body: While we can copy the interface of this class to our sdk-compat.h header, we also need to setup weak linking for the class itself, so better just skip it for now, as it provides no benefits over the fallback code.

commits.summary: Ensure build directory exists
Copy callbacks array before enumerating it (and invoking the callbacks)
commits.body: This is incase a callback makes changes to the callback array, as that is not supported for fast enumerations.

commits.summary: Checkin release notes for 2.0.11
Find in Folder: Allow navigating Recent Places with ⌘[ / ⌘]
commits.body: The pop-up menu will show shortcut keys next to the items that the keys will trigger, although we are re-purposing File Browser → Back / Forward for these actions, so it is worth considering moving them to the View menu.

commits.summary: Find in Folder: Only add to “Recent Places” when a search is executed
commits.body: Also add “file browser items” to Recent Places when a single folder is selected.

commits.summary: Add object type information when using OakHistoryList
Turn OakHistortyList into a generic class
Remove handling of SIGUSR1 (would previously cause a relaunch)
Use NSByteCountFormatter instead of text::format_size
Change a few leading spaces to tabs
Add missing implementation of isVisible property
Don’t keep local copy of find/replace string in Find singleton
commits.body: Instead we access the FFTextFieldViewController’s stringValue directly.

commits.summary: Make FFTextFieldViewController’s stringValue a public property

commits.summary: Add API to observe changes to a single file
commits.body:
While in theory just a wrapper for VNODE events, there are some edge cases:

- Observe missing file: Report when created (observe all ancestors to know).
- Rename ancestor: Treat as rename (observe all ancestors to know).
- Move observed file to trash: Treat as delete (reported as rename).
- Rename file with symbolic link in path (e.g. /tmp): Preserve symbolic path.
- Delete observed file and write new one: Treat as a write (reported as delete).
- Rename observed file and write new one: Treat as a write (reported as rename).
- Change case of file: Tricky on case-insensitive but preserving file systems because newPath != oldPath but both exist, so it looks the same as “rename and write new file” (previous case) that should be reported as write.

There is also an issue observing a symbolic link, here we should really observe both the link itself (does it get renamed or deleted) but also the resolved path (does this file get updated).

Currently though this is NOT implemented.

Previously I was using the previous method, but include folder has to be created when building on a new system, and it doesn’t avoid having to update the symbolic links if we add/remove frameworks to the project, so listing them all in the .tm_properties, while not ideal, is a better solution.
